mapper.insert: INSERT INTO packing_template (template_name, description, user_id) VALUES (#{templateName}, #{description}, #{user.id})
mapper.select: SELECT pt.*, u.id as user_id FROM packing_template pt LEFT JOIN user u ON pt.user_id = u.id WHERE pt.id = #{id}
SELECT pt.*, u.id as user_id FROM packing_template pt LEFT JOIN user u ON pt.user_id = u.id WHERE pt.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT pt.*, u.id as user_id FROM packing_template pt LEFT JOIN user u ON pt.user_id = u.id WHERE pt.user_id = #{userId} AND pt.template_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{templateName}, '%')
SELECT pt.*, u.id as user_id FROM packing_template pt LEFT JOIN user u ON pt.user_id = u.id WHERE pt.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pt.template_name ASC
SELECT pt.*, u.id as user_id FROM packing_template pt LEFT JOIN user u ON pt.user_id = u.id
